blocks.text: Thank you for the channel volumes your team sent through last week. We have most of what we need to start the economics for {{fact:f:E-2020-002.client}}, and the early read is that the split by route looks much as your operators described it. One gap is worth flagging while it is small. The direct and distributor volumes for the last two quarters arrive under a single line, so we cannot yet see the cost to serve for each of them on its own.

Two things would help from here. If someone on your side can separate those two lines, or simply point me to where the underlying detail sits, we can keep the cost picture moving without waiting on a full re-cut. And I would still like thirty minutes each with the two channel managers you flagged, so the economics are tested against how the channels really run.

On scheduling, Deborah Jimenez will hold times open late next week and send you a short list to choose from. Send whatever is easiest straight to me, Joseph Reed, and I will get it into the model the same day. I know this lands in a full week for you, Julie Gonzalez, and I have kept the asks as small as the work allows.
